name: Camp Shelly Ridge
description_short: Girl Scout day and overnight camp at the council's Shelly Ridge headquarters in Lafayette Hill, next to Chestnut Hill and Roxborough, for girls entering grades 1 to 12. Days include the pool, archery, hiking, climbing and low ropes, crafts and theme weeks; overnight campers sleep in a lodge or platform tents.

fees.name: Girl Scout membership
fees.note: Campers must be registered GSEP Girl Scouts; unregistered campers pay $45 at drop off. GSEP's financial aid page says the 2027 member year (October 2026 to September 2027) costs $25 per girl.

fees.name: Shelly Ridge Swim Club (4 to 5 PM group lesson)
fees.note: Swim Club plus extended care is $150 per week.

fees.name: Day camp bus from Philadelphia stops (round trip)
Day Camp Sleepover (week of August 10 only)

swim_waterfront_notes: Campers take a swim check at the start of the week in each section of the pool and are grouped by ability; some activities need a set swim level.

sessions.name: Day camp (8 weeks, 9 AM to 4 PM)
Overnight camp (7 weeks; half week, full week and multi week)

notes: Day camp drop off 8:30 to 9, pick up 4 to 4:40. Overnight full weeks run Sunday 3 to 5 PM to Friday 4:30 to 5:30 PM. Seven day camp bus stops in Philadelphia (West Philadelphia, Graduate Hospital, Center City). Weekly tuition is set per program in the GSEP camp guide and event calendar, which were not posted when checked. Non members buy a membership to register.
